'''Able Company''' was a squadron of ten veteran [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] that [[Skirmish in the Kwymar sector|fought]] in the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]].<ref name="DB" /> They were later dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goratak III]] to recover an [[I2-CG droid/Legends|I2-CG]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="CG" />
